name: MVSA Cannon
description:
Manufacturer: Behring
Item Type: Laser Cannon
Size: 2

The classic M4A has been specially retooled by Behring to create the VS (Vanguard Special), a laser weapon designed to meet the Aegis' unique requirements. The default nose-mounted weapon on the Vanguard Warden, the MVSA can only be loaded onto other Vanguard variants.
